listen_host.description: IP address to bind the TCP socket; leave empty to use Unix socket only (recommended for local services)

listen_port.description: TCP port for clamd communication (only used if listen_host is set)

socket_path.description: Path to the Unix socket file used by local tools (clamscan, etc.)

scan_user.description: System user under which the daemon runs — must have read access to scanned paths

max_threads.description: Maximum number of concurrent scan threads; higher values increase throughput but also CPU/memory usage

scan_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to scan a single file; increase for very large files

read_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for data from network connections (e.g., HTTP or FTP scanning)

max_recursion.description: Maximum archive nesting depth to scan (0 = unlimited)

max_files.description: Maximum number of files inside archives to scan

enable_compression_scan.description: Whether to decompress and scan inside archives like .gz and .bz2

max_scan_size_mb.description: Maximum size (MB) per file to scan; larger files are skipped (0 = unlimited)

max_archive_size_mb.description: Maximum total size (MB) of an archive to scan; larger archives are skipped (0 = unlimited)

enable_heuristic_scan.description: Enable heuristic analysis to detect unknown threats (may increase false positives)

enable_pua_scan.description: Enable detection of Potentially Unwanted Applications (PUAs) — may cause false positives in development environments

log_file.description: Path to the daemon log file (scan events, errors, startup info)

log_verbose.description: Log verbosity: 0 = errors only, 5 = debug (avoid 5 in production due to noise)

log_rotate.description: Enable automatic log rotation when max size is reached

log_rotate_max_size_mb.description: Maximum log file size (MB) before rotation

pid_file.description: Path to store the daemon’s PID file

database_directory.description: Directory where virus signatures (.cld/.cvd) are stored — must be writable by freshclam

enable_local_update.description: If enabled, logs update activity to database_directory (freshclam must run separately)

pua_categories.description: List of PUA categories to detect (e.g., 'Adware', 'Tool', 'Spyware'); only effective if enable_pua_scan=true

exclude_paths.description: List of file or directory paths to skip during scanning (to avoid system directories)

include_paths.description: Optional list of paths to scan exclusively (if empty, scan entire filesystem under root)

items.description: An absolute path to scan (e.g., '/home' or '/var/www')

enable_mail_scan.description: Enable scanning of email files (RFC822 parsing, multipart support)

enable_embedded_urls.description: Detect embedded URLs in documents (useful for phishing detection)

enable_archive_scan.description: Scan inside archives (ZIP, RAR, 7z, tar, etc.)

enable_broken_scan.description: Enable scanning of broken/invalid archives (may catch malformed threats but may cause errors)

enable_bytecode.description: Enable bytecode signatures (used by advanced ClamAV signatures)

extra_signatures_path.description: Optional directory with custom .crb/.ign files (e.g., internal rules)

enable_pe_scan.description: Scan Windows PE executables (essential for detecting malware on mixed platforms)

enable_pdf_scan.description: Scan PDF documents for malicious JavaScript and embedded files

enable_html_scan.description: Scan HTML for suspicious scripts and embedded objects

enable_office_scan.description: Scan Microsoft Office documents for macro viruses

enable_hwp_scan.description: Scan Korean HWP documents (required only in Korean environments)
